method: Exact delivered semantic skin masks partitioned into source-colour surfaces separated by drawn dark creases; component ownership follows reviewed finite limb segments. Visible head/neck/hands, torso, shorts and shoes excluded. Entirely hidden limb chains contribute no ownership. Source RGBA unchanged.

limitations: Visible surface ownership only: hidden anatomy is not reconstructed.
Upper/lower subdivisions use nearest guide segment; clothing must resolve its own cuff/fold and occlusion silhouettes.
Source motion blur and mixed edge colours remain in their source semantic ownership.
These are offline authoring aids; this index does not certify visual quality of an outfit.
